page.notes: Marginal notes on the right: "1.", "2." and "3." are section numbers; the Greek note (marked ') is illegible here and was not read. "Aristot. 7. Ethic. 5." is a reference. The "I." at the start of the paragraph stands in the left margin beside the initial D, so it is given as a note; if it is a section number of the text, it may belong in the paragraph. The reference mark ' in the text is doubtful in position. The final letter of "faciendā" is uncertain. The catchword "non" and the signature "I 3" are at the foot. The strip on the far left is the edge of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. No running head is printed, since the page opens a division.
